alt: 老人坐在街邊凝視一張記錄往昔鄰里互助的老照片；街上低頭看手機的路人漠然走過散落的蔬菜，只有一名男孩和紅背心外送員幫忙收拾。
scene_prompt: A reflective neighborhood scene where an elderly resident holds an old photo of neighbors helping one another, while busy pedestrians pass a dropped grocery bag and a child and volunteer stop to help, suggesting kindness can be restored.
